title: Mixed Event — At This Festival Bathed in Twilight

meta.Event: At This Festival Bathed in Twilight
meta.Outline: Mafuyu continues to study for her medical school entrance exams while developing some angst towards her mother. However, she ends up volunteering for a big festival called Shibuya Festa and...

rows.Line: After school
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: The study guides should be on this shelf...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (But where is the one that my teacher recommended going to be...?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(I can't find it...
What if it's in a different part of the store?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(I need to find it soon...
Mom's going to start worrying about me if I come home late again...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (She's already been asking me so many questions since that day I went to PXL...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Questions like, “Why are you late?” or, “Who were you with?”)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: She's just concerned because I wasn't able to take that practice exam, right...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Anyway, I need to find that study guide...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (It looks like the ones for medical school are on this shelf. If I look here...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Book Spine
rows.Line: “Seika College of Nursing - Past Exam Questions”

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: College of Nursing...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, I'm getting a call...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hello, Mom? Is something the matter...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: <Mafuyu, has school already let out?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: <Oh, I'm sorry for calling you so out of the blue like this. The thing is, I got you some of those snacks you seem to like since you don't have cram school today, but you were taking so long to come home.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Oh...
I'm sorry for making you worry so much about me.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: School is out, but I'm at the bookstore right now. Remember the study guide my teacher recommended that I told you about last night during dinner?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
<Ah, that's right.
Hehe. I'm so proud of you.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
<And I have you covered there.
I just happened to find that study guide at the bookstore in our neighborhood, so I decided to purchase it.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Oh, I see...
I'm glad since I was actually having trouble finding it here. Thank you, Mom.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: <Hehe. That study guide should keep you busy this weekend... So, why don't I make you some of your favorite stew this Saturday?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Really? That'd be great.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: <Since you'll be hard at work, I'll do my best to make it even more delicious than usual. Anyway...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: <Come home soon.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay, I will.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I really need to get home...
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (There's something going on outside of the station.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (It looks like they're setting up stalls on Main Street...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Oh, that poster... Miku's on it...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: “Shibuya Festa”...?
Asahina...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I had a feeling that it was you, Asahina!
I wasn't expecting to run into you here.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Hello, Hinomori.
Are you on your way home now?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, I am.
I stopped by this Japanese confectionary shop to buy some things today.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, since we have the opportunity, why don't we walk back together?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Sure, I don't mind.
Especially since we hardly ever walk home together.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Well, we are in different classes, and you usually have to rush home after club, yes?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Haha...
I sort of have to since I usually have cram school afterwards.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
That's so incredible...
Not only do you get good grades, you're also a talented archer, you're a class representative and you go to cram school.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. Not as incredible as you, Hinomori, since you do your best to attend club while being an active idol.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
It's getting very noisy.
I think they're setting up the stage or something.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Ah, I'm guessing it's for Shibuya Festa.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, like the thing from that poster...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, it's a festival that's going to be held for the very first time this weekend. It sounds like there's going to be all these stalls lined up along Main Street, while various events and activities are also taking place.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: There's even going to be a stage in Nonogi Park, and other exciting things will also be happening.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I see...
You seem to know quite a lot about this, Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe.
That's because MORE MORE JUMP! is going to perform at the Shibuya Festa stage.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Wait, really?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. A streamer we know called Nanamin is going to be the MC for the stage...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And she asked us if we'd like to be the opening act.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I had no idea...!
This is going to be a great opportunity for your group to get its name out there, Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. That's exactly why we're all so excited about it. It's rare to be able to perform on an outdoor stage, and it serves as a nice checkpoint leading up to our solo show.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Hehe. I'm happy for you.
I hope your performance at Shibuya Festa goes really well.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, thank you!
If you have some time, I hope you get a chance to stop by and watch.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm this way so...
See you later, Asahina!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay, see you.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Shibuya Festa...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I had no idea that it was happening.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (But it's not like I'll have anything to do with it...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay, I'll play the new demo now.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Whoa...!
This one really knows how to find its way into your heart.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes... It's so beautiful...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Especially the sound that the violin makes. It's so simple, but it's really soothing...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Okay, I've got an idea!
I'm going to draw the perfect illustration for this. Just wait, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thank you.
I'll be looking forward to seeing the video you and Mizuki come up with.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
What do you think, Mafuyu...?
Is there anything that bothers you?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Not particularly.
I should be able to start writing the lyrics for it immediately.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
That's good to hear.
Then, why don't we all get straight to work?

rows.Speaker: Ena, Mizuki & Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Okay.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, this sort of doesn't have anything to do with the demo...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But is anyone here thinking about going to Shibuya Festa this weekend?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, that's this weekend?
It's gonna be so crowded outside the station.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, but it is its inaugural year, so it might not be so bad. Still, it's hard to imagine a festival not being packed with people...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Shibuya Festa...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah! This festival called Shibuya Festa's about to take place!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Main Street's gonna be closed off to pedestrians only, and there's gonna be all sorts of food stalls. Caramel apples, crepes, you name it. The area outside the station's gonna be all of that from wall to wall.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
That sounds fun...
It'd be kind of nice if I could go...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, it could be fun...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
It's absolutely gonna be fun!
I even heard that they're gonna have people performing on an outdoor stage!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I really wanna see the stage MC!
I mean, who wouldn't want to see the super-famous former idol known as...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Nanamin?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, that's... Wait, what?!
How do you know her name, Mafuyu?!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Hinomori told me earlier...
Her group was invited to perform by Nanamin personally.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
What?! MMJ's gonna be performing?!
That means we gotta go early to claim a good spot!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: That means Airi and Minori are gonna be performing too. I kinda want to go see them now.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Me too...
Especially after how moved I was by Hanasato's performance at the Fan Festival...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, while we're on the subject, Ms. Mochizuki mentioned the other day that she'll also be performing...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hold on, Honami plays music?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right.
I don't think I told you, Ena.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hoshino, who we went to SpoJoy Park the other day with, is Ms. Mochizuki's childhood friend. They're in a band together and are trying to go pro.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What?! Is that true?!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes.
So, I'd like to go see them if possible.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Right... Hmm... If all these people I know are gonna be performing, I probably really should go.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Then, let's all go together!
We'll get to have tons of fun since stuff's gonna be happening all day!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, mind if we check out the art exhibit at some point? This artist I really like is supposedly going to have some pieces on display there.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
There's going to be an art exhibit...?
I'd like to see that as well.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, totally!
We should see as much stuff as we can♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
How do you feel, Mafuyu?
Are you gonna be too busy studying during the weekend?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: <Hehe. That study guide should keep you busy this weekend... So, why don't I make you some of your favorite stew this Saturday?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Just don't regret your decision, okay...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
...
I'll need some time to think about it.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Okay, but...
You're always free to let us know if you think you can go.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, we'll wait as long as you need!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'd like it if you could join us, but you don't need to force yourself...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay...
The next day
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Shibuya Festa...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I promised Mom that I'd work on that study guide this weekend...)

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Oh, Asahina, perfect! Are you free right now?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Y-Yes...
How can I help you?

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: I apologize for asking you this so suddenly, but would you be interested in doing some volunteer work?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Volunteer work?

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Yes, that's right. The thing is, Shibuya Festa is looking for student volunteers.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Unfortunately, we've been having trouble attracting any takers... So, Asahina, would you mind helping out? I have a feeling that you'd do a wonderful job.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: However, you're free to refuse, since I know that your studies keep you very busy.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (If I volunteer, then I might be able to see the others...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Understood.
If someone like myself will suffice, I'd like to help.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: I really appreciate it, Asahina! Thank you very much! In that case... Here's a written overview of what volunteering for it will involve.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: You should hear further details on the day of, so I suggest you ask any questions you have then.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Thank you. I will.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (What does volunteering for this involve anyway...?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (“We will be assigning volunteers to help with one of the following: providing information to guests, donation collection, crowd control, first aid...”)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: First aid...?
Kamiyama High School - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Okay, Rui, it's this weekend!
Our moment of truth!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, and all the decorations seemed to be coming along nicely outside the station. I'm very much looking forward to the day of.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Still, it's hard to believe that we were invited to perform on stage for Shibuya Festa.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh.
Not just invited... But invited as sponsors no less!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: As sponsors...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yup!
So, uh... That means... Actually, what does that mean?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Um...
Based on the message that Emu's brothers sent...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: General participants will be performing from morning until late afternoon, and the evening is being reserved for corporate sponsors...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, now it makes sense!
Thanks, Nene♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Which means we'll be participating as representatives of Phoenix Wonderland. I'm happy to hear that we're being held in such high regard.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And we'll need to put on a wondrous show to meet everybody's expectations.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Performing at Shibuya Festa will be no different from our ambassadorial performances! We'll need to do our best to ensure Phoenix Wonderland receives even more visitors!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Speaking of which, didn't you mention something about modifying the device for the flying scene? Have you already gone through with that?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, it's nearly done, so I should be able to bring it by during tomorrow's practice.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I hope you're looking forward to trying out my new and improved Super Deluxe Ejection Mechanism♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm... The name isn't helping...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. Oh, don't worry...
Hm?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Uh oh.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Tsukasa, Kamishiro, hello to the both of you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, Akito, Toya!
It's so nice to see the two of you!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, um... Hello...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh, that flyer you have there...
Is it for Shibuya Festa?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, we're actually going to be performing at this event's outdoor stage.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?! You and your team are too, Toya?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Does that mean you and your troupe will be performing as well, Tsukasa...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes.
Phoenix Wonderland is a corporate sponsor, so we'll be there as its representatives.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
A sponsor...?
That's incredible. I promise to go see your performance.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, I hope you enjoy it!
I guarantee an absolutely fantastic show!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: By the way, how did you end up performing at this event?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: A friend from back in elementary school is a part of the operations team for Shibuya Festa.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: He asked me and Toya to perform on stage for the Summer Festival, and it went better than any of us expected...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Which led to him asking us if we'd like to perform as a team this time.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We thought it'd be a good experience for us since we hardly ever get to perform anywhere outside of live houses.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see. That makes quite a bit of sense.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Do you know when you and your team will be performing, Toya?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We'll be the last performers for the general participants, so sometime towards the evening...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The last of the general participants?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Rui, don't we take the stage after the general participants?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, that's right.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We'll be the first act for the sponsors... That equates to us performing directly after Vivid BAD SQUAD.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That means we'll simultaneously be the headliners and the opening act for Tsukasa's troupe.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, you're right.
But our performance might please the crowd so much that they end up leaving before seeing yours.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh?! That's some pretty big talk! But you shouldn't underestimate us! Our show may just completely overwrite all of their memories from that day!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. But this is very exciting.
We'll finally get to see one of your team's performances, Aoyagi.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, let's both give it our best.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, let's!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Aha, interesting♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Rui and Li'l Bro are both performing.
This just keeps getting better and better! I should tell everybody in N25 about what just happened!
Asahina Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm back.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Welcome home, Mafuyu.
You must've spent quite a bit of time studying.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: How did your cram school class go?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: We had a test-taking seminar for medical schools, which was a bit challenging.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But the teacher said that I should be able to learn to answer questions quickly as long as I learn the right patterns.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Oh, that does sound challenging.
But your teacher's right. I'm sure you'll be just fine, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: You have that study guide to go through, so as long as you give it your best shot this weekend...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, Mom, about that...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Hm? Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I'm sorry...
I'm not sure that I'll have much time to study this weekend. I'm going to do some volunteer work.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Volunteer work?
Why now...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: My teacher at school was struggling to find student volunteers, and I got asked to help out.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Your teacher...? I see...
That's a shame since you were planning on studying so much this weekend. But you're a good girl, so it's no surprise that you were asked to do this...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I can always call your teacher if it seems like it's going to be too much. Would you like me to...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Th-That's okay...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'll get points for my record at school, and it should help when it comes to my school interviews.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It'll give me an advantage when I do take my exams, so it's not all bad, right?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Yes, you may be right. It'll be worth doing if it'll give you an advantage in that regard...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: It's a shame to see you lose studying time, but my hands are tied if you feel it's necessary...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I do, Mom. And I'm sorry.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
It's okay.
You'll just have to pick things back up next weekend.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Anyway, I'll be in my room studying until dinner.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Oh, before you go...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Is anyone from your class also volunteering? Anybody from different years or schools?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, I was asked about it just today, so I don't really know. Why do you ask...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. I just thought that it'd make your job a little bit easier knowing that you'd be working with a friend.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Anyway, Mafuyu, do your best.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay...
Mafuyu's Room

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <What?! Yuki, you can go?!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <But we won't be able to meet until the evening since I have to volunteer until then.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Still, that's great...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah, how did you convince your mom...? That couldn't have been easy.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I told her that I'd be working past dark, so I should be fine as long as I don't come home too late.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<I see.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Definitely! We won't be able to see much stuff together during the day, but we should check out all the stalls and stage performances at night!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<What?! Akito's performing?!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Hehe. It'll be a chance to hear all kinds of different music, Yuki.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Yes, it will...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Anyway, I need to get back to studying. I'll see you all again at 25:00.>

The day before Shibuya Festa
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, why don't we call things here for today?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Nice work, everyone!
Tomorrow's finally Shibuya Festa!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Right.
I'm a little nervous since we won't be playing in front of our usual kind of audience.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I understand how you feel. It probably is going to feel a bit different. This reminds me of the first time we performed with anemone...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, that was definitely a hard one to the gut.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. And yet, you were all ultimately able to get through to that audience with your song, yes?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So, I'm sure this performance will go just fine. As long as you give it your best, I'm sure people will be willing to listen.

Cool!

rows.Line: (Did our eyes just...?)

rows.Speaker: Minori, Haruka, Airi & Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you very much!

rows.Line:

rows.Line:
Nice work out there!

rows.Line:
Wah!
A-Airi, that tickles!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She's right. Compared to before, you've been dancing without holding back or feeling nervous at all. I think we have our training camp to thank for that.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I agree. The audience seemed to really enjoy everything too. Hehe...

rows.Line:
This seems so strange.
When we first formed, we weren't really sure what to do.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But now, the four of us are here performing on stage together and spreading hope to all these people.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Next is our solo show.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah.
And we're absolutely 100% gonna make this a success!

rows.Speaker: Minori, Shizuku & Haruka
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Yes!

rows.Line: Um, are there any vending machines around here?

rows.Line: Excuse me. East Elementary's dance performance hasn't begun yet, right?!

rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Line:

rows.Line:

rows.Line:

My name is Mafuyu Asahina, and I'm a second-year.

rows.Line: Wow...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
This is so cool, Ichi!

rows.Line: You're saying that while literally standing in front of her... But I understand what you mean.

rows.Line: Haha... No, I'm hardly what you call perfect.

rows.Line: By the way, what are you handing out? Those look like flyers of some sort...

rows.Line: Yes, that's right. We're doing what we can to make sure people remember our names since we get to perform on such a big stage.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: A lot of people end up throwing away flyers and ads, but they do help in terms of getting our name out there.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And make it so as many people as possible come hear our songs!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I see. You all certainly seem to have a plan. It's very impressive. Would you mind if I took one as well?

rows.Line:
Yes, of course!
Here you go!

rows.Line:
Thank you.

rows.Line:

You designed this, Mochizuki?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh...!
Th-That's...!

rows.Line: Hona's the one who drew that lion!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Oh, this is a lion?
I apologize for mistaking it for a sun.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
N-No, that's okay!
If anything, I should be the one apologizing because of how funny it turned out.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
No, actually...
It's very unique and has left a bit of an impression on me.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
R-Really...?!
Thank goodness!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
The thing is...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But your friend, Ena, she was kind enough to teach me, and I did learn to draw a little better...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We want to go pro together, so we're doing everything we can to make that happen.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Because the four of us going pro together is our big dream!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right. So let's all do our very best today!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Their big dream...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. You're willing to face your weaknesses and try to overcome them for the sake of making your dream come true. That's very admirable.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I hope that as many people here get to hear your music as possible.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, thank you!

rows.Line:
Wow! This is amazing!
Look at all the stalls!

rows.Line: Oh, they have a shooting gallery over there! Nene, we should go give it a try♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: W-Wait, Emu! Hold on!

rows.Line: Hehe. They certainly seem to be enjoying themselves.

rows.Line:
Yes, indeed!
It's only natural to get excited when you're at a festival like this!

rows.Line:
However, it's not just stalls here...
I'm seeing all these bronze statues and wooden sculptures. That's not something you normally see at these kinds of events.

rows.Line: Ah, that may be because Shibuya Festa is partly a celebration of the arts. I remember seeing that there's an art exhibit somewhere.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Interesting! They've taken a rather experimental approach to this festival.

rows.Line: Oh, there's even a piano sitting in the middle of the street. I may just have to come back and play something once our show is done!

rows.Line:
Let's go get some cotton candy!

rows.Line:

rows.Line: Oh, um... I'm sorry for running into you!

rows.Line:
Hehe. You're forgiven.
For saying such a nice apology, here's a little reward.

rows.Speaker: Child
rows.Line:
Wow! It's a balloon puppy!
Can I really have this...?

rows.Line:
Of course.
I hope you enjoy the festival, but be careful not to get hurt.

rows.Line: Thank you! I'll be careful!!

rows.Line:
Where did you get that thing from?

rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Line: Mizuki?

rows.Line: They're currently going through the performances by elementary schools, so it's a bit crowded backstage. We'll head over a little later.

rows.Line:

rows.Line:

rows.Line:

rows.Line: (So the person Emu was trying to cheer up that time was Mizuki's friend, Mafuyu.)

rows.Speaker: Ena

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:

I bet she's gonna feel even better after seeing you guys' show today, Emu!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, and it's good to hear that her senior is also feeling better!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I still don't have all the details, but for Emu and this other person's sake, I'd like to do what I can during today's show...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki

rows.Line:
Then, let's all go together!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Excellent! We're heading to the same place!

rows.Line: So, let us go see Saki and her band play!

rows.Line:

rows.Line:

rows.Line: Hey!

rows.Line:

rows.Line: (I'm seeing Momoi and her friends over that way. It looks like they're disguising themselves to blend in.)

rows.Line:

rows.Line: Hehe. I'm really looking forward to hearing Hoshino sing. Especially since I haven't really heard her sing during a show yet...

rows.Line:

rows.Line:

rows.Line: Anyway, we'll see you again once you're finished volunteering!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm...?
Akiyama seems to be waving to someone.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
What?!
A-Asahina?! She's here?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Ah, so it is her...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High Schooler
rows.Line:
E-Excuse me!
Can you tell me where the restrooms are?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, they're straight down this path...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hm?
Is something the matter, Emu?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Asahina doesn't seem very happy today either...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (She seems more or less normal to me...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But Emu has a way of knowing how others feel, so there may be something going on that I'm not seeing.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (And figuring out how someone else feels is no simple matter.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Even understanding how oneself feels can be difficult. It wouldn't be good to intrude or overstep my bounds...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, the show's about to start!!
Saki!! You can do it!!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hello, everyone! We're Leo/need!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Most of you are probably seeing us for the first time, so we're hoping that our show helps you remember who we are.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We actually did our very first show as a band at an outdoor venue like this one. We all felt really nervous that time and I even had a little trouble singing...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But that experience led us to our current goal... To become professional musicians.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Since then, we've been writing our own songs with original lyrics. We've had our share of successes and failures...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But we want to play in a way that really moves people's hearts. We want to do that more than anything.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We've poured everything we have into each of our songs, so I hope you enjoy them! And please enjoy the show!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: One, two, three, four!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Whoa! They're so cool...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Hoshino's gotten so much better...
I'm probably gonna need to start asking her for lessons.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
So much power!
They must've been practicing a ton! It's clear just by the way they're singing!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Their bassist is also really good.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, and their rhythm section's in perfect sync. Also, their songs have this way of reaching into your heart.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I can totally tell why you really like them, Kanade! It's like they're exuding cuteness and coolness at the same time!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Hoshino's singing voice is so pretty and has so much power... But her band is also playing incredibly as a whole.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Ms. Mochizuki and the others must've practiced quite a lot until this point...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Play in a way that moves people's hearts...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'd heard that Saki's band was trying to go pro, but this is completely beyond what I was expecting...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Honami, you're so cool!
And wonderhoy!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You're doing great, Saki! Keep it up, Leo/need!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, but again, we're nowhere near that level yet...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I'm hoping that we'll be able to write and play those kinds of songs someday...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I want us to be that kind of band.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Again, my chest...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: What is this feeling...?
Backstage

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Great job, everyone!
That was a super amazing show!!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, and we got a good response from the crowd...! I think we were able to make full use of everything we learned during our training sessions.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Even though we were playing at an outdoor venue, Ichika, your voice seemed to reach pretty far. It looked like even the people way in the back could hear you well.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, it was great to see everyone having so much fun! Thanks for suggesting that we perform at Shibuya Festa, Hona!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. You're very welcome!

rows.Speaker: Spectator A
rows.Line:
That band was really good.
What was their name again?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Spectator B
rows.Line: Oh, the flyer I got from them should say. Leo/need. I remember them saying that they usually perform at live houses.

rows.Speaker: Spectator A
rows.Line:
Really?
It might be fun to go hear them play sometime.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Whoa...!
Our flyer helped them remember our band name!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
That's incredible...!
Thank you for making them, Honami, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Y-You're welcome...!
I couldn't be happier...!

rows.Speaker: Spectator A
rows.Line: Hang on. What's this thing? A sea urchin?

rows.Speaker: Spectator B
rows.Line: Huh? I thought it was a scrubbing brush.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh...
I guess it really doesn't look like a lion...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I wouldn't worry too much about that. The important thing is that they remember who we are.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Right.
We can keep trying different ideas regarding that while doing our best to have more people listen to our songs.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So let's keep up the good work!

rows.Speaker: Saki, Honami & Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line:
Our next team will be doing a belly dance performance!
The stage is all yours!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, this dance routine's pretty cool!
Actually, all the teams up to this point have been really good!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I agree. From what I've been hearing, the opening act was also fairly spectacular.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Oh, that was Momoi's group.
It would've been nice to see their performance. Too bad we had morning practice...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I really wanted to see Minori and her group perform too... We should go see them together the next time we can!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Totally!
But Leo/need was also really good. The crowd went nuts when they played!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, and they played with so much power... I think it's the most energy I've felt from an act all day.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah.
Hm...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sorry, I need to go for a bit.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hm? Where are you going, Akito?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Shota asked me to do a soundcheck with him. I'll be right back.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Then, I'll also...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, this shouldn't take long at all. You guys wait here. I'll be right back.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Thank you, Shinonome.
We'll see you in a little bit.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, I never knew that such a dance existed! This is turning into quite a nice learning opportunity!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wow! That's so cool!
I wanna try doing something like that too.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Then, let's try it together... Eep!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Wh-Whoa...!
It's a really strong gust...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
The wind's starting to pick up.
But the forecast said it's gonna be sunny today.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You're right...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Our act is fast approaching, so I may want to change and start making my final checks.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh? Final checks?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
For the Super Deluxe Ejection Device.
I'd like to make some adjustments to it since attempting to fly in these winds would prove rather perilous.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Tsukasa, you and the others stay here and enjoy everyone's performances since Saki and her band will also be joining you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Right, well...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Then, we'll stay here.
Thanks, Rui.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, I'll go with you!
Things should go faster if we work together♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thank you, Emu.
Then, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Okay, Rui, Emu, good luck!
Backstage

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hmm... This wind is very concerning...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I'm glad I decided to check up on it.
Somebody was bound to get hurt if we decided to fire it at its normal power in this weather.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, somebody getting hurt would turn everyone's smiles upside down...! Is there anything I can do to help, Rui?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Then, would you mind handing me the screwdriver that's in the toolbox there?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Roger! Here you are!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Thank you.
...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Based on the wind's speed and direction, I should lower the power a little more...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Okay, that should do it.
But I really should test it out first.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, wanna try it on me?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
No, I'll do it.
My build is closer to that of Tsukasa's.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, I know...!
I'll lay down some mats to make sure you don't get hurt!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Ah, much appreciated.
Now, for your own safety, you're going to need to move away from the device.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Alright, I'll engage the switch and...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Three, two, one...
se_event_festival_2022_001

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Whoa! That's so amazing!
Rui, you went all whoosh into the air!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thank you.
I was able to land where I intended to.
This power setting should do just fine.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But let's test it once more just to make sure.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Three, two, one... Huh?!
se_event_festival_2022_001
se_event_festival_2022_003

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(Uh oh...!
The wind's pushing me towards...!)
se_event_festival_2022_003

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oof...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
R-Rui!
Are you okay?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes... Well, maybe not...
The wind made me miss my mark, and I seem to have gotten injured as a result.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
What?!
Where?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: My hands and elbows... I seem to have scraped them during the landing. Also, I think I twisted my right ankle. I hope this pain goes down before our show.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
We have to treat you quickly!
Uhh... Uhh...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
But we should be fine now...
If random gusts are all we have to worry about, then I just have to make the right adjustments. As long as he sticks the landing...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Rui, that's not important right now!
We have to take care of you somehow!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Because we won't be able to put on a smile-filled show without you!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, right...
My apologies, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But it's nothing serious, so as long as we disinfect my wounds and bandage them up, I should be... Ow!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What's wrong?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
This is bad...
My leg hurts more than I realized.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I know! Where's the first aid kit...?!
Wait, no! We should find the nurse's office or whatever the equivalent is here...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Shota seems pretty busy...
I guess operations isn't exactly an easy job.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, what are you doing sitting in a place like this?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Ah, Shinonome.
You seem to have caught me at a bad time.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
A-Akito!
Thank goodness you're here!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: The thing is, Rui made this device that makes him go whoosh through the air, but the wind blew at a bad time and he got hurt!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I don't know what to do since I'm not sure where the nurse's office is for this place...!!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Whoa, Otori, calm down...
Nurse's office? You mean the first aid tent?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, that!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Ah, but I'm okay...
Shinonome, your team is performing soon, so I'll be fine on my own...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: *Wince*

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Rui...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Looks like we have no choice...
Kamishiro, hang onto my shoulder.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
But you have a performance to do.
You don't have time to be doing any of this, do you...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, not really...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: B-But if we don't, we won't be able to do our show, Rui...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That's...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Don't you remember what you said that one time? The thing about doing whatever it takes to make a show succeed.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No, I am simply trying to give this ceremony the show that it deserves.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Which is why I'll do anything right now if it means convincing you to join us.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I feel no guilt over that whatsoever.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: If you really meant that, then you should be asking others for help right now.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, you're right...
Okay, I'll gladly accept your assistance.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
And there's nothing wrong with that.
Now, where's the first aid tent...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Um, where was it...?!
Uhh... Wait, I know!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Asahina's volunteering at the festival, and she's assigned to this area right now. She might know where it is!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Asahina...? That girl from before...?)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I think she was... Aha!
Asahina!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Otori...?
First Aid Tent

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: This is the first aid tent.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thank you so much, Asahina!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
You're welcome.
But getting injured before your performance is quite unfortunate... I hope you feel better soon.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Anyway, let's ask whoever's in charge for... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: There's no one here...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Huh?
Yeah, you're right! Why is that?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: They may be somewhere else dealing with a separate injury or accident...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Seriously?
We came all this way... Are you going to be okay in time for your show?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We may not have a choice. We can't not do our show, so I'll have to perform like this if need be.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: B-But it really hurts when you walk, right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We need to give your foot support by wrapping it, but we probably shouldn't use any of their supplies without asking first...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Would you like me to do it?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: The instruction sheet that I was given said that volunteers are allowed to use any supplies and equipment they need.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Also, if we don't treat this soon, it's going to get worse.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Thank you...
Then, if you don't mind.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Understood.
Otori, would you mind looking for the first aid kit with me? It should be somewhere on that shelf.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yes, ma'am!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(I knew she seemed familiar...
I think she's in the same music group as Ena...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Asahina, I found the first aid kit!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thank you.
Let's see what we have...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Well, she seems pretty reliable, so I guess we can leave the rest to her...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You played no small part in saving me, Shinonome. I really appreciate what you did.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
And your team is performing soon, no?
I'm sure you need some time to get prepared, so please feel free to go.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Right.
Then, I'll be going...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Oh...
I'll let Tsukasa and Kusanagi know about what happened.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh, um... That won't be necessary...
I wouldn't want them to begin worrying just as we're about to perform.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Fortunately, my role in this show is a minor one. I won't be putting a damper on Tsukasa and the others' performances.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's not the problem here...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm saying that you shouldn't try to do everything yourself if you want to produce something good.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. You're right...
Then, would you mind telling them?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Sure thing.
Is there anything else you'd like me to tell them?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
In that case...
Can you tell them that I'll be right there and they don't need to worry?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Okay.
Then, I'll see you later on stage.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Alright, see you later.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay, I have everything I need, so I'll begin treating you. Um...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, my name is Kamishiro.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay, Kamishiro, we'll start by going over your symptoms. Does it hurt when I press here?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, a little.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I see. I believe it's a minor sprain.
We'll need to ice it for a bit.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thank you so much, Asahina!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I hope this means you can still be in our show, Rui...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Right. That's why you're all here.
Ideally, you should rest and stay off it...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But for now, we'll ice it and try to get you enough time to rest. I'll go and get the ice bag.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, you've been a great help.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay, all done.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's not a good idea to walk on it immediately, so you'll want to stay off it and rest until your show is about to start.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
That was amazing, Asahina!
You treated him all zing-zang-zoom...!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Hehe. It was nothing, really.
Oh, in these sorts of situations, it's always important to keep RICE in mind.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Rice? Like the food?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Rest, Ice, Compression and Elevation.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's how you're supposed to treat sprains and strains, and it's a good mnemonic to remember for those situations.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Whoa...!
It's like you're a real doctor!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Where did you learn all that?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's just something I came across while studying for entrance exams into medical school...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, Asahina, you're studying to become a doctor? That explains why you seemed to know what you were doing.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, um... That's right...

rows.Speaker: Stall Worker
rows.Line:
Sorry, are there any first aiders here?!
I got a little burned while using the hot plate at the yakisoba stall...!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, um... If you wait just a moment, I'll...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
No, you should go help them out.
Outside of my scrapes, you've already done plenty for me.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Thank you.
I'll be right back.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, the burn area's pretty large. We'll need to use the sink next door...

rows.Speaker: Stall Worker
rows.Line:
Sorry.
I really appreciate it... Ow!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Are you feeling okay?
We'll need to move quickly since it's easy for burns to leave scars.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
It was just for a second...
But I think Asahina just smiled...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I couldn't actually tell the difference just now...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But she does seem more at ease compared to when I saw her for the first time...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Okay, all finished.
You should be fine now, but please have a doctor look at it if possible.

rows.Speaker: Stall Worker
rows.Line:
Thanks, miss! That was incredible!
I really appreciate what you did for me!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
It was nothing.
I'm just glad that I could help.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (This is just my guess...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But she doesn't seem like a doctor. More like a...)
Shibuya Festa - First Aid Tent

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Thank you for your patience.
How does your foot feel?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Ah, much better.
It's been hurting considerably less since you treated it.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, that's good to hear.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Then, why don't we start applying some gauze to those scrapes?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Still, there are quite a few.
What caused this exactly?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, we were testing the ejection device that we'll be using during our show.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Ejection device?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yup!
It's a device that lets the user jump up really high!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But a strong gust blew while Rui was testing it and...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well, I ended up getting injured as a result.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I see...
I guess putting on a show is no simple matter.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, they have their challenges.
Moving around large props is hard, physical work, and it becomes necessary to make adjustments to our various gadgets when the weather turns for the worse.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: However...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: They're super duper fun!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Getting to do shows with everyone's the best! It's hard sometimes, but I wake up every day looking forward to working on them!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Especially the ones Rui comes up with! They're always, fun, exciting and super wonderhoy!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, yes...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Being able to put on the shows that I want to has made me very happy.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: The shows you want to...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (That feeling... It's back...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hm...?
Is something wrong, Asahina?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu

rows.Line: The truth is, when I was little, I also didn't know what I wanted to do or become.

rows.Line: At first, I thought I'd be happy as long as I was able to make the shows I wanted. Even if I had to do it alone.

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: “There once was a demon who lived all alone.”

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line:
“And this demon had one job...
To corrupt humanity.”

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: “As such, this demon became responsible for the downfall of several humans. However...”

rows.Speaker: Demon
rows.Line:
“Heh heh heh!
Finally! I have reached my 1,000th victim!”

rows.Speaker: Demon
rows.Line: ”A feat unmatched by others! Not even those from the underworld! All shall cheer and hail my name!”

rows.Speaker: Demon
rows.Line: “Alas...”

rows.Speaker: Demon
rows.Line: “Things have been far too easy as of late... I've accomplished my goal of reaching 1,000 victims, but feel no sense of satisfaction.”

rows.Speaker: Demon
rows.Line: “Is there no better way to entertain myself...?”

rows.Speaker: Little Demon
rows.Line: “Festival, festival♪ A fun, fun festival♪”

rows.Speaker: Demon
rows.Line:
“Hm?
That demon over there looks awfully small and weak...”

rows.Speaker: Demon
rows.Line:
“But it seems rather happy.
You there!”

rows.Speaker: Little Demon
rows.Line: “Hm? Can I help you?”

rows.Speaker: Demon
rows.Line:
“What are you doing?
You seem far too happy for your own good...”

rows.Speaker: Little Demon
rows.Line: “Oh, I was just about to put a festival together!”

rows.Speaker: Demon
rows.Line:
“A festival...? Yes, I see...
One held in the name of demons, which serves to corrupt humanity!”

rows.Speaker: Little Demon
rows.Line: “What? No!”

rows.Speaker: Little Demon
rows.Line: “I just want to have a festival where everyone can have fun and be happy! I don't want corrupting humanity to have anything to do with it!”

rows.Speaker: Demon
rows.Line: “Huh?”

rows.Speaker: Demon
rows.Line: “What kind of festival put on by a demon doesn't revolve around corrupting humans?! You are supposed to have them engage in merrymaking and encourage them to become more hedonistic...”

rows.Speaker: Little Demon
rows.Line:
“No, I'm bored of doing that.
I don't like how they essentially become zombies in the end...”

rows.Speaker: Little Demon
rows.Line: “Which is why I think a fun and happy festival would be much better!”

rows.Speaker: Little Demon
rows.Line:
“We can put one on together!
A happy, demonic festival that everyone can enjoy!
Let's go!”

rows.Speaker: Demon
rows.Line: “H-Hey, don't yank me!”

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. It's like Tsukasa and Emu in real life!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's funny how they're just being themselves, even though they're supposed to be scary demons.

rows.Speaker: Little Demon
rows.Line:
“I brought a new recruit!
It should be a lot easier to put on our festival now!”

rows.Speaker: Older Demon
rows.Line: “Ah, so there are other strange folk like us still around. Who exactly did you...? Huh?”

rows.Speaker: Older Demon
rows.Line: “Wait, this is the biggest and baddest demon of them all! The one who corrupted 1,000 humans! What's he doing here...?!”

rows.Speaker: Demon
rows.Line: “I was brought here all of a sudden...”

rows.Speaker: Older Demon
rows.Line:
“This is bad!
If the more powerful demons find out about us putting on a happy festival that has nothing to do with corrupting humans, we're going to be in big trouble.”

rows.Speaker: Little Demon
rows.Line:
“We are?
But I thought it'd be fun if we brought him along since he seemed so bored.”

rows.Speaker: Older Demon
rows.Line:
“Argh! That's not the point!
If the others find out, they'll lock us up in the underworld and make it so we can't come back to the human world!”

rows.Speaker: Little Demon
rows.Line: “Really?”

rows.Speaker: Older Demon
rows.Line:
“Yes, really!
Get it through that thick skull of yours already!”

rows.Speaker: Demon
rows.Line:
“What fools...
However... Hmm...”

rows.Speaker: Demon
rows.Line: “Did you make these decorations and costumes for this festival of yours?”

rows.Speaker: Older Demon
rows.Line:
“Y-Yes...
The human I used to follow around was someone who made outfits for festivals...”

rows.Speaker: Older Demon
rows.Line: “I was going to corrupt them, but they died of an illness before I could... The costumes they left behind were very beautiful, so I decided to try making copies of them.”

rows.Speaker: Older Demon
rows.Line: “Before I knew it, I was having fun.”

rows.Speaker: Demon
rows.Line:
“I see...
Fine, I'll play along since I have nothing better to do at the moment.”

rows.Speaker: Older Demon
rows.Line: “Really?! You will?!”

rows.Speaker: Demon
rows.Line:
“Yes! I shall aid thee!
And if I become bored, I'll just report you to the bosses for a tidy reward.”

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Th-That's awful...!
This demon really is evil!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: He looks like the Tsukasa I'm used to seeing, but he really is quite good at playing less-than-savory characters.

rows.Speaker: Demon
rows.Line:
“Now, where do you need me to begin?
I should have no issues accomplishing whatever it is that you need of me.”

rows.Speaker: Older Demon
rows.Line: “Then, can you come up with ideas for our festival?”

rows.Speaker: Demon
rows.Line:
“Yes, no problem!
I know! We can get these humans intoxicated and...”

rows.Speaker: Older Demon
rows.Line: “No using charm potions on the humans.”

rows.Speaker: Little Demon
rows.Line: “Oh, one of us still needs to make the device for shooting fireworks!”

rows.Speaker: Demon
rows.Line:
“Ah, that sounds fun!
With my magic, I should be able to...”

rows.Speaker: Little Demon
rows.Line: “But no using magic! It's too dangerous!”

rows.Speaker: Demon
rows.Line: “Grr... This is becoming very bothersome...!!”

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I always love Tsukasa's performances where he goes along with Emu and the others' antics...! He's so good at interacting with them!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, he is.
Hang on. Isn't he just being himself for those parts?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Interesting. He's supposed to be this all-powerful, evil demon, but he's beginning to see how fun it is to put on a festival as he interacts with these demons that see things differently to him.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Which means, pretty soon...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I-It's him...)

rows.Speaker: Smiling Demon
rows.Line: “Ah, I heard you're the one who corrupted 1,000 humans. Congratulations!”

rows.Speaker: Demon
rows.Line:
“Th-Thank you...
However, it was but a trifle to me.”

rows.Speaker: Smiling Demon
rows.Line:
“Indeed.
But I was wondering why I hadn't seen you in the human world lately. What have you been up to?”

rows.Speaker: Demon
rows.Line:
“Oh, I've been on vacation...
It seemed like I was in need of a break is all!”

rows.Speaker: Smiling Demon
rows.Line: “A vacation? I see.”

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (He's walking normally...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I guess his foot's fine now...)

rows.Speaker: Demon
rows.Line: “Stop! Unhand me at once!”

rows.Speaker: Little Demon
rows.Line: “P-Please, let us out!”

rows.Speaker: Older Demon
rows.Line: “How did you find out about us putting on a festival?! We didn't tell anyone...”

rows.Speaker: Smiling Demon
rows.Line:
“Ah, I had a feeling...
Demons like you lot appear from time to time.”

rows.Speaker: Smiling Demon
rows.Line: “Honestly, demons trying to make humans happy. How foolish...”

rows.Speaker: Demon
rows.Line: “Urgh...”

rows.Speaker: Demon
rows.Line: “Then, let me ask you this... Is corrupting humans that much fun? Is that what you truly wish to do?”

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (What he truly wishes to do...)

rows.Speaker: Smiling Demon
rows.Line:
“This is not a matter of fun.
We have an important role to play in this world.”

rows.Speaker: Demon
rows.Line:
“Why are you prioritizing that?!
Our role in this world doesn't matter! I... I just want to...”

rows.Speaker: Smiling Demon
rows.Line:
“Shout all you want...
You will receive your punishment shortly.”

rows.Speaker: Demon
rows.Line:
“Blast...!
What are we to do...?”

rows.Speaker: Little Demon
rows.Line: “They brought all our things for the festival here too. Does that mean they're going to throw them all away...?”

rows.Speaker: Demon
rows.Line: “Our things for the festival...? That's it!”

rows.Speaker: Older Demon
rows.Line: “Huh? What are you doing?”

rows.Speaker: Demon
rows.Line:
“Here we are!
This is the device I made for launching fireworks...!”

rows.Speaker: Demon
rows.Line: “We'll escape to the human world using this!”

rows.Speaker: Little Demon & Older Demon
rows.Line: “What?!”

rows.Speaker: Older Demon
rows.Line:
“That's impossible!
I mean, yes, we're imprisoned at the bottom of the abyss with no roof or ceiling in sight...”

rows.Speaker: Little Demon
rows.Line:
“But if we don't make it and fall...
We're goners...!!”

rows.Speaker: Demon
rows.Line:
“I don't care...
This is what I want to do.”

rows.Speaker: Demon
rows.Line: “I want to put on that festival with you two!”

rows.Speaker: Demon
rows.Line:
“I'll go first!
If I manage to succeed, follow me up!”

rows.Speaker: Demon
rows.Line:
“Here we go!
One, two... Three!”

rows.Line:
That was really good.
I'm glad we got to see it together, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, me too...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Rui's troupe put on such a good show! Li'l Bro and his team did an awesome performance too! Oh...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Good evening.
Did you enjoy our show?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, it was amazing!
I was so moved by the scene where Tsukasa flew! I still can't believe you made that device, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What?! You made that?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yes, he did...
He has a bit of a talent for that.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's because our director here's a genius!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Says the person who was quivering before launch.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Th-They don't need to know that!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I hate to interrupt...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But I'd like to say how our show was only possible because of you, Asahina. Thank you very much for what you did.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We were only able to do our show the way we did because you were kind enough to treat my injury.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Our shows mean quite a lot to me, so I can't even begin to express how grateful I am for your help.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thank you so very much, Asahina!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, and we apologize for not thanking you sooner. We appreciate what you did and were able to put on a fantastic show as a result!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
If you like, please stop by the Wonder Stage for another show. We'd love to see you there.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: From the bottom of my heart, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Um, it was nothing...
I'm just glad that I could help.
Still...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I enjoyed your show.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hm?
They seem like friends all of a sudden.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, they do...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, since the show's over, wanna check out the stalls and exhibit? You don't have much time left, right, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, right...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, let's go!
Shibuya Festa - Stage Area

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Alright, let's start exploring!
Where do you wanna start?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: We already went to the art exhibit, so I'm good with whatever...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Mafuyu, why don't we go take a look at the stalls since you've been around the stage all day?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Sure.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, there's a little less people now...
This should make it easier to walk around.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yeah, way less than during the day.
We can go for a nice little stroll.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Is everything okay, Mafuyu?
Do you feel tired...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
No, it's not that...
I was just thinking about what happened today.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: About what happened today?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Yes.
I saw Hinomori and her group perform, met Hoshino and her band... And I treated Kamishiro...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Also...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm inclined to believe otherwise...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This is just my hunch, but I got the sense that there is something that you want to do, Asahina.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (What I want to do...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I don't think I actually want to do...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Mafuyu...?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: *Sob*

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh no! What happened to that little girl? Do you think she's lost?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Looks like it.
Let's try to help. We can't just leave her like this.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hi, are you okay?
Did you get separated from your parents?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: *Cry*

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Whoa! Wh-What did I do...?
I didn't say anything weird, did I?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, Ena, look...
She scraped her knee. I think she's crying because it hurts.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
What?
Oh, you're right... And she must terrified since her mom's not around to help her...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Then, why don't we take her over to the first aid tent?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Do you think she can walk? She's sort of planted herself onto the ground. And I don't think we're strong enough to carry her...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I know! We can bring someone over from the first aid tent! Let's see... It was...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
*Sob*
M-Mommy, it hurts...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Our shows mean quite a lot to me, so I can't even begin to express how grateful I am for your help.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thank you so very much, Asahina!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Mafuyu...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Are you okay...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Do you think you can stand...?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
I-It hurts...
I fell over by the flower beds...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, you poor thing...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (It looks like just a scratch...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Do any of you have any water on you...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, I do...
Here, I just bought this a second ago. I haven't even opened it yet!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Mind if I borrow it?
I'll pay you back later.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Sure thing!
I mean, given the situation, you can have it!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (First, I need to clean out her wound.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Then, I'll dry it off using a handkerchief and place a bandage on it...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (And finally...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Pain, pain, go away...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Does it still hurt?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
*Sob*
Huh...? It doesn't hurt anymore...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: That's good to hear...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
That was amazing!
Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Of course. You're very welcome.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Oh, it's Mommy!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
What?
Oh, there's a lady running over...!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: There you are! Thank goodness I found you! Wait, did you get hurt?!

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
Yeah...
But this nice lady helped me!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
I see...
Thank you very much. How do I repay you for helping my daughter...?!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: No, it was nothing...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
Thank you, nice lady!
Bye bye!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Bye bye....

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: What's the matter, everyone...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehe. I think we're all just really happy!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Happy? Why...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hang on...
Don't you realize what just happened?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You smiled ever so slightly when that little girl thanked you...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(I smiled...
Why...?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Hang on...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (When Kamishiro and Otori thanked me just earlier...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (My chest felt light for some reason...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Why is that...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Anyway, now that she's been reunited with her mom, let's get back to enjoying the festival.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Mafuyu, you don't have much time left, so we should... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Everyone!
Are you enjoying Shibuya Festa?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Look! Miku's on the big screen by the Scramble Crossing! Well, to be fair, she's pretty different from our Miku...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <You came all this way, so I hope you all get to have fun today!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <And to make sure you all have a lovely day, I'm going to sing lots and lots for you!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes, she's different...
But I also see some similarities.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Our Miku also likes to sing to get close to others.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, you're right!
And we should take Miku's words to heart by trying to have as much fun as possible!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Agreed. Isn't there anything that you really want to see or do, Mafuyu? The rest of us have pretty much gone where we want, so feel free to speak up.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (What I want to see or do...?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I want to...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hm? Is something the matter, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Is somebody playing the piano...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right.
Where's it coming from?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hey, isn't it that?
There's a piano sitting in the middle of the street, and I see someone playing it.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: A piano...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'll give up on music...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: That means you don't need this synthesizer anymore, right? I'll hold onto it for now.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I haven't touched any musical instruments since then...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I wonder what happened to that synthesizer. Did she throw it out already...?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Mafuyu...
Would you like to play the piano?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You seem to be very interested in it. I was wondering if you wanted to play it...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I do...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I want to try playing it...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, why not?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I totally wanna hear you play, Mafuyu!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, looks like it's free now!
Have fun!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, isn't this one of Kanade's songs...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Not only that, it's the one that made Mafuyu smile for the first time.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Mafuyu...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Mafuyu, would you mind if I played with you...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: If that's what you'd like, Kanade...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thank you.
I'll sit right next to you.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Man, Shibuya Festa was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hm? Those people playing the piano...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Isn't that Kanade and Asahina...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, they're playing the street piano.
Hehe. What a lovely song...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Indeed!
It suits the melancholy feel of dusk perfectly!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That's so cool! I didn't know Asahina could play...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, Rui...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hm? Yes, Emu?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I hope she discovers what she truly wants to do someday.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, so do I.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Mafuyu...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Are you having fun right now?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
...
I'm not sure...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But I'd like to keep doing this for a little bit longer.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Then, let's keep playing a bit more.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay.
